name: First differences of sums of two squares.
comment: Sequence includes arbitrarily large values as well as infinitely many 1s.

maple: b:= proc(n) option remember; local j, k;
for j from 0 to isqrt(iquo(k, 2)) do
if issqr(k-j^2) then return k fi
program: (PARI) show(lim)=my(v=vectorsmall(lim\=1),u=List(),t=1); for(m=1,sqrtint(lim), for(n=1,sqrtint(lim-m^2), v[m^2+n^2]=1)); for(i=2,#v, if(v[i], listput(u, i-t); t=i)); Vec(u) \\ _Charles R Greathouse IV_, Mar 31 2015
